# BHG Forklift Training

> BHG Forklift Training provides onsite forklift operator training and hands-on evaluations for all seven OSHA powered industrial truck classes. It is a service of BHG Safety Partners LLC, a Disabled Veteran-Owned company based in Hannibal, Missouri, and serves employers across the Midwest and South.

## Contact Information

- **Phone:** (573) 822-6448
- **Email:** info@bhgsafety.com
- **Address:** 11325 Dove Ridge Road, Hannibal, MO 63401
- **Website:** https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com
- **Parent company:** BHG Safety Partners, https://bhgsafety.com

## What We Do

Training is delivered at the client's facility, on the trucks operators actually use. Each program covers the three parts OSHA's rule (29 CFR 1910.178(l)) requires: formal instruction, practical hands-on training, and an evaluation of each operator's performance in the workplace. Training is available in English and Spanish.

## Forklift Classes

- **Class 1** — Electric motor rider trucks: https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-1-forklift
- **Class 2** — Electric narrow aisle trucks (reach trucks, order pickers): https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-2-forklift
- **Class 3** — Electric hand trucks (pallet jacks, walkies, walkie-riders): https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-3-forklift
- **Class 4** — Internal combustion trucks with cushion tires: https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-4-forklift
- **Class 5** — Internal combustion trucks with pneumatic tires: https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-5-forklift
- **Class 6** — Electric and internal combustion tow tractors: https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-6-forklift
- **Class 7** — Rough terrain forklifts and telehandlers: https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes/class-7-forklift

All classes: https://www.bhgforklifttraining.com/classes

## Other Safety Services

OSHA 10 and 30 hour courses, HAZWOPER, confined space, first aid/CPR, safety consulting, audits and inspections are offered by the parent company, BHG Safety Partners, at https://bhgsafety.com.
